answer: The proof should live in two places at once. Proof of insurance claim history via underwriter loss record exists in duplicate: a loss record the underwriter has kept since the first claim. The umber of the duplicate is the second copy - held by a different office, in a different town, under a different lock. To fake one identity a farm must alter both copies, and the comet of the alteration is the journey: two offices, two clerks, two chances to be refused. The ocean that settles the question is the mismatch - copies that disagree expose the hand that changed one.
